propositions: Four AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT firings on 2026-08-12 exceeded the 1800s DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX bound by 10-130s (1810s, 1820s, 1810s, 1930s observed), killing in-flight LLM-Review processes during a 60+-merge landing burst.

The current 1800s bound is 1.5x REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (1200s) and is marginally insufficient for burst scenarios; raising to 2400s (2.0x) absorbs the observed overshoots with 470s margin above the worst case.

The DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX default must remain anchored to a fixed multiple of REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS to self-adjust when the per-review cap changes, enforced by test assertions rather than free-floating literals.

A saturated-episode scenario from piranha (7b4a-0f39-1a45-4ce9) showed in_flight oscillating without reaching zero for 30 minutes; the 2400s raise does not fix saturation but defers the interrupt by 600s, and saturation detection remains an open residue.
